title: Evaluating Cellularity Estimation Methods: Comparing AI Counting with Pathologists' Visual Estimates
summary: AI cellularity estimates were compared directly with pathologists’ visual estimates in a defined tissue-analysis task. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: AI cellularity estimates were compared directly with pathologists’ visual estimates in a defined tissue-analysis task.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
